_doc: Auditor history + pension funded ratio per obligor for predictive detector library. Auditor change is FY most-recent vs FY prior. Pension funded ratio = fair value of plan assets / projected benefit obligation (DB pension only; multi-employer church/state plans not disaggregable).
_methodology: Local data/mdas/*.txt searched first. Where local file unavailable or unreadable (CID-encoded PDFs), web search + WebFetch used. ~3-search cap per obligor enforced; unverified obligors marked LOW with _warning. Pension data sourced from 'Employee Benefit Plans' or 'Pension and Postretirement Benefits' footnote near back of audited FS.

pension_funded_ratio._notes: DC plan only — Adventist Health operating entities participate in a single defined contribution plan (the 'Plan'). No defined-benefit pension obligation reported.

Multi-employer church plan (Seventh-day Adventist Retirement Plan for North American Division, administered by GC in Silver Spring MD). Frozen Dec 31, 1999; transitioned to DC plan (AHRP) effective Jan 1, 2021. Per FASB, multi-employer plans not required and not possible to disaggregate plan net assets for University apart from other participants. University contributed $3.0M (FY24) and $3.3M (FY23) for retiree pension + healthcare benefits.

auditor_change._notes: Allegheny Health Network (AHN) is a subsidiary of Highmark Health. Audited FS reviewed is Highmark Health consolidated. Audit signed by PwC Hartford CT office.

pension_funded_ratio._notes: Parent Highmark Health DB pension (consolidated). Comprised of 4 legacy plans: Highmark Retirement Plan, West Penn Allegheny Health System, Jefferson Retirement Plan, Saint Vincent Health System Pension Plan. All frozen by or before Dec 31, 2020. Plan is OVERFUNDED at 110.5% (assets $3.113B vs PBO $2.818B). Separately, Highmark NY pension is included. AHN-specific carve-out not separately disclosed.
